advisory.known_vulnerability_claim: The existing audit reports no known vulnerabilities; this advisory is a maintenance notice, not a clean-bill-of-security proof.
advisory.decision: Retain the pinned tested stable framework. Official v0.8.22 still declares paste1.0. No compatible stable upstream version removing it was found by the Oct8 cutoff. Track upstream migration; reevaluate on a stable release, rebuild WASM, repeat UI tests and cargo audit. Do not rename/override a transitive macro crate without a tested upstream dependency change.
advisory.maintained_framework_evidence: Official stable release Oct5 includes active fixes and dependency maintenance. This supports maintained Leptos, while the separate paste dependency remains unmaintained.
advisory.possible_alternatives: RustSec lists pastey and with_builtin_macros; these require an upstream migration or maintained tested fork, not an application-level version bump.
advisory.retrieval_limit: crates.io API retrieval returned403; direct official GitHub API/tagged manifest and existing resolved lock/metadata provided release/dependency evidence.

checkpoint_reconstruction.observation: Existing services checkpoint JSON names tasks and final files but contains no executable intermediate snapshot recipe.
checkpoint_reconstruction.proposal: Root-owned materializer should explicitly map each checkpoint to source snapshot/patch sequence and a standalone Cargo.toml with [workspace], concrete pins and resolvable relative path dependencies. Copy into a new learner directory; reject overwrite; preserve immutable reference helpers; use the course mise shared target. Validate cargo metadata for every materialized stage and compile/test each stage contract. Source recipes stay small; never package compiled targets.
checkpoint_reconstruction.status: Reported to root; mechanism implementation not owned or claimed verified by this audit.
